goal: Prevent malformed frontier result envelopes from being reprocessed forever by quarantining a generic ingest failure exactly once while preserving diagnostics and all existing success/replay semantics.
acceptance: Generic ingest failures are atomically moved out of active incoming processing.
The original failed envelope is preserved in quarantine and diagnostics are persisted separately.
A second consumer invocation does not retry the same failed envelope.
Success and replay return-code 2 semantics remain unchanged.
A deterministic regression oracle proves quarantine-once behavior.
An independent structured reviewer reports PASS with no concrete defect.
Builder and reviewer have no Git write or merge authority.
